value.rationale: For natural Euclidean Steiner intrinsic volumes, the first three are forced by graph order and degree in the entire triangle-free regular class, while the fourth has a universal strictly negative one-square step. This detects a motivated graph structure geometrically, in an infinite class with a real 14-vertex cubic separation; it is neither an arbitrary finite slice nor a known-table recomputation. Its combinatorial proof is a five-forest-family four-edge classification, not a mere substitution into the general determinant identity.
